name: findphone
description: FindPhone monorepo: Flutter app (mobile/), web dashboard (web/), Firebase backend (firebase/).

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run gen && cd mobile && flutter pub get
scripts.test:mobile: cd mobile && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.test: npm run check:generated && npm run check:contrast && npm run test:web && npm run test:mobile && npm run test:rules
scripts.test:web: npm run typecheck -w web && npm run lint -w web && npm test -w web
